title: Protesting GMC Rajouri employees stop Chief Secretary’s cavalcade over recruitment rules notification

ai.summary: Protesting employees of GMC Rajouri stopped Chief Secretary's cavalcade to demand notification of service recruitment rules pending for seven years, affecting healthcare services.

facts.claim: Protesting employees of the Non-Gazetted Cadre of Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri stopped the cavalcade of Chief Secretary Jammu and Kashmir, Dr. Sajjan Singh Yadav
facts.quote: Chaotic scenes were witnessed in Rajouri on Tuesday afternoon when protesting employees of the Non-Gazetted Cadre of Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri stopped the cavalcade of Chief Secretary Jammu and Kashmir, Dr. Sajjan Singh Yadav, demanding notification of their long-pending service recruitment rules.

facts.claim: The employees have been on an indefinite protest for the last nine days
facts.quote: The employees, who have been on an indefinite protest for the last nine days, are seeking notification of service recruitment rules that have remained pending for nearly seven years since the establishment of five new Government Medical Colleges in Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.claim: The rules have remained pending for nearly seven years since the establishment of five new Government Medical Colleges in Jammu and Kashmir
facts.quote: The employees, who have been on an indefinite protest for the last nine days, are seeking notification of service recruitment rules that have remained pending for nearly seven years since the establishment of five new Government Medical Colleges in Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.claim: The prolonged delay in notifying the rules has stalled their career progression and affected fresh recruitment in these institutions, ultimately impacting healthcare services and patient care
facts.quote: The protesting employees allege that the prolonged delay in notifying the rules has stalled their career progression and affected fresh recruitment in these institutions, ultimately impacting healthcare services and patient care.

facts.claim: On Tuesday, during his maiden district visit to Rajouri, the Chief Secretary visited GMC Rajouri to review the available facilities
facts.quote: On Tuesday, during his maiden district visit to Rajouri, the Chief Secretary visited GMC Rajouri to review the available facilities.

facts.claim: Dr. Yadav informed them that although he had assumed charge only three days ago, he was aware of the issue and had already discussed the matter with the Secretary, Health and Medical Education Department
facts.quote: Dr. Yadav subsequently interacted with the employees and listened to their concerns. The employees apprised him of the situation, stating that the prolonged uncertainty had left them with no option but to resort to protests, which were also affecting hospital functioning and patient care.

facts.claim: The service recruitment rules had been forwarded by the Health and Medical Education Department to the Finance Department and would subsequently require approval from the Finance Department and ARI and Trainings Department before being submitted to the Lieutenant Governor for final approval
facts.quote: He said the service recruitment rules had been forwarded by the Health and Medical Education Department to the Finance Department and would subsequently require approval from the Finance Department and ARI and Trainings Department before being submitted to the Lieutenant Governor for final approval.

facts.claim: Dr. Yadav assured the employees that the entire process would be completed within one month and the recruitment rules notified accordingly
facts.quote: Assuring personal intervention, Dr. Yadav said he would convene a meeting with all concerned departments within the next 24 hours to expedite the approval process. He assured the employees that the entire process would be completed within one month and the recruitment rules notified accordingly.
